title: Wall Mount 24-Inch Towel Bar (Solid Brass) - Mambo Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass, designed for 24-inch center-to-center installation and made to coordinate with the mambo collection.

  • Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, tailored look
  • Wall-mounted design helps save floor space
  • Designer coordination—ideal for matching mambo pieces and statement bath accessories
  • Hardware included: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware

Specifications

  • Category: Towel Bars
  • Collection: Mambo
  • Shape: Straight bar
  • Center-to-center: 24 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.5 in
  • Overall dimensions: 25 in W x 3 in H
  • Projection: 3 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Assembly required: False
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including distinctive choices such as Venetian Bronze, Antique Pewter, Lavender, Glokzin Teal, and Unlacquered Brass.
